description: This script automates the process of managing build dependencies and targets for the ANGLE project, including traversing dependency graphs, validating includes, and outputting flattened build target information.

methods.name: run_checked
methods.description: Executes a subprocess command with error checking, printing the command to stderr.

methods.name: dag_traverse
methods.description: Performs a depth-first traversal of a dependency graph, applying pre- and post-recursion functions.

methods.name: flattened_target
methods.description: Flattens a build target's dependencies into a single dictionary, stopping at library types if specified.

methods.name: has_all_includes
methods.description: Checks if all include directives in source files are valid and acceptable.

methods.name: gather_libraries
methods.description: Collects all library targets starting from specified roots, validating includes.
